messages:
Sarah L.: Heads up — I landed an exports map change in @redwood/sdk-js that was supposed to straighten up CJS/ESM entrypoints.
Sarah L.: After the change our edge sample app started failing in the edge runtime CI (V8 isolate). Quick repro in CI: import errors.
Ben K.: Oof. Any error logs? which entrypoint did you change?
Sarah L.: The change collapsed a few entries into conditionals so package.json now exposes: \n  \"exports\": {\n    \"./*\": {\"require\": \"./dist/cjs/*.js\", \"import\": \"./dist/esm/*.js\"},\n    \"./node\": {\"require\": \"./dist/cjs/node.js\", \"default\": \"./dist/esm/node.js\"}\n  }\nBut the edge samples import from \"@redwood/sdk-js/edge\" and the resolver picks the wrong conditional in some runtimes.
Mike P.: Error snippet from CI: \n```
Error: Cannot find module 'file:///repo/node_modules/@redwood/sdk-js/dist/esm/edge.js'\n\nWhile resolving import \"@redwood/sdk-js/edge\" from /workspace/samples/chat/edge/index.mjs
    at Loader.resolve (internal/modules/esm/loader.js:...)\n    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:...)
```
Ben K.: That looks like ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED or resolution mismatch between node and the edge bundler. Did we change subpath pattern or the wildcard handling?
Sarah L.: Yep — I switched to a wildcard to reduce duplicated entries, thought it was fine. But apparently bun/deno/edge embedder treat the \"./*\" mapping differently vs Node 18. They sometimes prefer the CJS path or fail to map extless imports.
Jamie (eng): Also getting TS/IDE complaints: types still point at cjs/index.d.ts which has commonjs-style exports and breaks auto-imports in TS server. People see wrong typings in samples.
Ben K.: Quick mitigation — revert to explicit subpaths for the edge-facing entrypoints (./edge, ./edge.mjs, ./edge.js) and add a dedicated conditional for runtimes that set \"default\" or \"import\". Can we hotfix in a patch release?
Sarah L.: Yes, planning a revert PR now. Will open a follow-up to audit all sample imports and add a test that runs the Edge sample bundling in CI. Apologies for the breakage :facepalm:
devex-bot: created issue #412: "exports map wildcard causes edge sample resolution failures" and assigned to Sarah L.
Mike P.: Once reverted let's also publish a canary tag for teams to smoke test before we cut the next release. Need to add a test for the TypeScript declaration paths too.
Ben K.: Agreed. Also add a short note in the changelog to avoid surprise for integrators that rely on exact subpaths. Slack thread -> file issue in monorepo, and maybe a recipe in docs for edge consumers.
Sarah L.: Sounds good. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/789 (revert + tests). I'll follow up once CI green. :shipit:
Jamie (eng): Thanks — ping me if you want me to run the smoke on the internal samples list.
Ben K.: Thanks Sarah. We'll keep this in the canary for 24h before promoting
